newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Central Norseman lifts gold yield 4.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Central Norseman lifts gold yield 4.2 pct.

text.p: Western Australia miner Central Norseman Gold Corp Ltd said on Monday it produced 4.2 percent more gold in 1996/97 (July-June) compared with the previous year after increasing its treatement of ore.
The company said it produced a total of 124,602 ounces in the latest financial year versus 119,622 ounces the previous year.
The higher yield was achieved by treating 25.8 percent more ore, albeit at a lower grade, Central Norseman said.
